sloka: रूपिणीम् विषसम्युक्ताम् पीत्वेव मदिराम् नरह् ।अनृतैर्बहु माम् सान्वैःसा न्त्वयन्ती स्म स्मभाषसे ॥२-१२-७७॥
transliteration: rūpiṇīm viṣasamyuktām pītveva madirām narah ।anṛtairbahu mām sānvaiḥsā ntvayantī sma smabhāṣase ॥2-12-77॥

translations.english: You used to console me with so many words pleasing but untrue and you killed me like a hunter getting the deer trapped and slaughtered through the melody of music.
